title: Connecting Meta WhatsApp Cloud API & SMS Gateways

intro.title: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Setup
intro.subtitle: Configure Phone Number ID, WABA account, permanent tokens, and webhook sync

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 7, Part 4: Connecting Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and SMS Gateways. Direct Meta integration enables sending verified digital tax invoices, PDF receipts, and refill alerts with maximum deliverability.
Go to Settings and select WhatsApp Business. The setup dashboard allows entering official Meta Developer credentials.
Enter your Meta Phone Number ID, WhatsApp Business Account ID, and permanent System User Access Token generated in Meta Business Manager.
Configure your Webhook Verify Token to enable real-time bidirectional message sync with the pharmacy inbox.
Toggle the connection to Active and click Save Configuration. Your pharmacy is now directly connected to the official Meta Cloud API. In Part 5, we explore the WhatsApp Live Inbox!

outro.takeaway: WhatsApp Cloud API: Connect your official Meta business number to dispatch verified PDF invoices, appointment reminders, and automated refill notifications.
